title: common/libnetwork: fix pesto port publish on connect
body:
This fixes a bug in the recent pesto logic which causes the podman network reload system test to fail.

The problem is we can have a network with only an ipv4 and then later connect a network with ipv6 or vice versa. The code therefore must check the network status separately.

Fixes: f95a3303d9 ("pesto: integrate port forwarding into netavark Setup/Teardown with state tracking")
